title: Battle of Alcañiz
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Alcañiz", at revision 1370431516, opens: "The Battle of Alcañiz resulted in the defeat of Major-General Louis Gabriel Suchet's French army on 23 May 1809 by a Spanish force under General Joaquín Blake y Joyes." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4870252, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1809 battle during the Peninsular War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
